test.title: Three literal Sand readings of the frozen Funky Upheaval source

encoding.printedTextPolicy: Every printedText string is byte-identical in UTF-8 to the reviewed draft. Literal case, punctuation, visible physical wraps and stored word spacing are frozen as this declared transcription model.
encoding.wordSpacing: One U+0020 between visible word chunks; no leading/trailing or repeated U+0020, tabs, CR or LF inside a row. Raster spacing widths are not represented.
encoding.apostrophes: Retain existing U+0027 ASCII apostrophe bytes. Apostrophe presence was visually reviewed; original typesetting codepoints are not recovered from raster ink.
encoding.longDashes: Retain existing U+2014 em dash bytes, including the printed110 row-final Nobel Prize dash.
encoding.bookTitleQuotationMarks: Retain existing U+201C/U+201D double quotation marks in the printed111 work list, including the period before the final closing quote. Other stored quote bytes remain unchanged.
encoding.case: Retain all literal case, including FiAT CUCkS. No case folding or style-based case repair.
encoding.physicalRows: One JSON record per reviewed physical content row; no hard-wrap joining or fragment expansion.

sourceModel.ordering: Stored source order; remove only title rows, then one global content-row index.

readings.rule: First nonempty U+0020-delimited chunk of each retained row, preserving every glyph; join with one U+0020. Stop if a first chunk contains no ASCII letter/digit.
Whole retained rows numbered 1,3,...,111 globally after title exclusion; join with LF.
Whole retained rows numbered 2,4,...,110 globally after title exclusion; join with LF; predeclared parity control.

outputPolicy.safeReceipt: RESULT.json: fixed technical fields, aggregate counts and output-integrity hashes only; no raw strings or row locators.
outputPolicy.hashMeaning: SHA-256 of UTF-8 output bytes is an integrity identifier only, never a scalar/key derivation.
outputPolicy.semanticOutcome: No semantic verdict is computed. Independent full-reading reviews follow separately.

authorityEvidence.role: Provenance only; no text from this file is used by the reading generator.
authorityEvidence.caveat: The creator-linked blog demonstrates first-word and alternate-whole-line readings; its current presentation includes later corrections, including one dated December 28, 2022, after the creator December 26 post.

limitations: Exact issue/date and applicability to the December 2022 plural-key claim remain unverified.
The March 2023 mirror clue and 20-BTC claim are not assigned to this column.
This is one frozen transcription/encoding model, not recovered original typesetting bytes.
The population excludes title rows, running furniture, decorative text, opener/art and adjacent ads as declared.
Three related source readings are not independent theories or statistical trials.
Successful generation is neither semantic recognition nor a claim that a message, key or cipher is absent.

reviewPlan.independence: Review all three complete saved outputs; reviewers do not receive each other's conclusions. They know the puzzle context and are not blinded to source or hypothesis.
reviewPlan.secondMessageCriterion: Directly coherent second message without omitted/substituted words, additional decoding or arbitrary selected substring. Ordinary cover-prose fragments and isolated thematic words are insufficient.
reviewPlan.instructionCriterion: A concrete action and target/unit/source anchor must be stated, without filling gaps.
reviewPlan.positiveHandling: Keep potential message/key-looking material private; a follow-up needs a separate fixed protocol.
reviewPlan.nonrecognitionWording: No clear second message was recognized in these three fixed literal readings.
reviewPlan.nonrecognitionScope: Subjective AI nonrecognition, not a formal message, key, article or cipher-family exclusion.
reviewPlan.inconclusive: Pin/source failure, incomplete reading or unresolved reviewer disagreement.
prohibitedFollowups: No additional transforms, selected substrings, word deletions or substitutions.
No format/checksum validators, wordlist filtering, prose-to-key hashing, derivation or network.
